# FlowSight Individual

> FlowSight Individual is a private productivity and focus tracker that uses local AI on the user's device.

Canonical website: https://solo.flowsight.site
Machine-readable pricing: https://solo.flowsight.site/pricing.md
Company website: https://flowsight.site
Security: https://flowsight.site/security
Privacy: https://flowsight.site/privacy-policy
Source code: https://github.com/Mancasvel/FlowSight.AI

Core product facts:

- FlowSight analyses screen context locally to identify focus, context-switching, and work patterns.
- Raw screen context is not uploaded to a manager-facing activity feed.
- Free local mode works without an account.
- Optional paid cloud features include AI coaching, a weekly PDF digest, and longer history.
- Desktop releases are published for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- FlowSight Individual is designed for the person doing the work, not for employee surveillance.

Note: llms.txt is provided as optional machine-readable context. Google Search does not use it as a ranking signal.
